title: Busy
subtitle: 「忙碌／繁忙／擠迫／被佔用」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「忙碌／繁忙／擠迫／被佔用」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: 和 busy 非常接近，可形容人正在做某事，也可形容房間、座位、線路已被使用。
words.example: I'm occupied with another task at the moment.
words.exampleZh: 我目前正忙於另一項工作。

exercises.original: I'm busy with another task at the moment.
exercises.zh: 我目前正忙於另一項工作。
exercises.upgrade: I'm occupied with another task at the moment.

options.explanation: 和 busy with 非常接近，稍正式。
表示有成果，不等於目前忙著某事。

exercises.original: She was busy answering customer calls all morning.
exercises.zh: 她整個早上都忙著接聽顧客電話。
exercises.upgrade: She was occupied with answering customer calls all morning.

options.explanation: 表示整段時間都在處理一項工作。

exercises.original: The consultation room is busy right now, so please wait.
exercises.zh: 診症室目前正在使用，請稍候。
exercises.upgrade: The consultation room is occupied right now, so please wait.

options.explanation: 房間被使用時非常自然。
安靜與是否被使用無關。
不能自然形容房間被佔用。

words.meaning: 正忙著；正從事；已被佔用
words.note: 表示某人正在進行某活動，或某電話線正在使用中。
words.example: She's engaged in a meeting right now.

exercises.original: She is busy in a meeting at the moment.
exercises.zh: 她現在正忙於開會。
exercises.upgrade: She is engaged in a meeting at the moment.

options.explanation: 較正式地表示正在從事某活動。
通常形容位置或房間空著。

exercises.original: He was busy in conversation when I arrived.
exercises.zh: 我到達時，他正忙於談話。
exercises.upgrade: He was engaged in conversation when I arrived.

options.explanation: engaged in conversation 是常見搭配。
不適合形容人的忙碌狀態。

exercises.original: I tried to call, but the line was busy.
exercises.zh: 我嘗試打電話，但電話佔線。
exercises.upgrade: I tried to call, but the line was engaged.

options.explanation: 英式英語中電話 engaged = busy。
可表示啟用，但不等於正在佔線。

words.note: 非常自然的口語表達，表示因其他事情纏身而暫時不能處理別的事。
words.example: I'm tied up with meetings all afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 我整個下午都忙著開會，抽不開身。

exercises.original: I'm busy with meetings all afternoon.
exercises.zh: 我整個下午都忙著開會，抽不開身。
exercises.upgrade: I'm tied up with meetings all afternoon.

options.explanation: 口語自然，表示完全抽不開身。

exercises.original: She is too busy to take another call right now.
exercises.zh: 她現在忙得抽不出時間接另一通電話。
exercises.upgrade: She's tied up right now and can't take another call.

options.explanation: 表示目前已有事情纏身。

exercises.original: The manager is busy until three o'clock.
exercises.zh: 經理三點前都抽不開身。
exercises.upgrade: The manager is tied up until three o'clock.

options.explanation: 表示暫時沒有時間處理其他事情。

words.note: 形容日程、一天、工作環境等非常繁忙，而且節奏快、壓力大。
words.example: It's been a hectic week at the office.
words.exampleZh: 這星期辦公室工作非常繁忙。

exercises.original: It's been a very busy week at work.
exercises.zh: 這星期工作非常繁忙緊張。
exercises.upgrade: It's been a hectic week at work.

options.explanation: 表示節奏快、事情多、壓力大。

exercises.original: We had a busy morning with back-to-back appointments.
exercises.zh: 我們早上行程非常繁忙，預約一個接一個。
exercises.upgrade: We had a hectic morning with back-to-back appointments.

exercises.original: Her schedule becomes especially busy at the end of the month.
exercises.zh: 她月底的日程特別繁忙。
exercises.upgrade: Her schedule becomes especially hectic at the end of the month.

options.explanation: 形容 schedule 非常自然。

words.meaning: 排得滿滿的；非常繁忙的
words.note: 表示日程、一天、行程已安排很多事情。
words.example: I have a packed schedule tomorrow.
words.exampleZh: 我明天的行程排得滿滿的。

exercises.original: I have a busy schedule tomorrow.
exercises.zh: 我明天的日程排得滿滿的。
exercises.upgrade: I have a packed schedule tomorrow.

options.explanation: packed schedule 是固定自然搭配。
不是「行程很滿」的近義詞。

exercises.original: It was a busy day with six separate appointments.
exercises.zh: 那天行程排得很滿，有六個不同預約。
exercises.upgrade: It was a packed day with six separate appointments.

options.explanation: 活動安排很多時非常自然。

exercises.original: The conference programme is busy from morning until evening.
exercises.zh: 會議議程由早到晚排得滿滿的。
exercises.upgrade: The conference programme is packed from morning until evening.

options.explanation: 節目／議程安排很多，最自然。

words.meaning: 排滿的；沒有空位／時間的
words.note: 當 busy 指日程沒有空檔時，full 很自然。
words.example: My calendar is full until Friday.
words.exampleZh: 我的日程排到星期五都沒有空檔。

exercises.original: My calendar is busy until Friday.
exercises.zh: 我的日程到星期五都排滿了。
exercises.upgrade: My calendar is full until Friday.

exercises.original: The doctor's schedule is busy all afternoon.
exercises.zh: 醫生整個下午的日程都排滿了。
exercises.upgrade: The doctor's schedule is full all afternoon.

exercises.original: We're very busy this week and cannot accept more appointments.
exercises.zh: 我們這星期安排已滿，不能再接受預約。
exercises.upgrade: We're fully booked this week and cannot accept more appointments.

options.explanation: 比單獨 full 更自然地表示預約已滿。

words.note: 可形容市場、帳戶、地區、時間段或某人持續有很多活動。
words.example: The market is particularly active in the morning.

exercises.original: The market is especially busy in the morning.
exercises.zh: 市場早上特別活躍繁忙。
exercises.upgrade: The market is especially active in the morning.

options.explanation: 強調交易／活動多，而非單純人多。

exercises.original: This is the busiest period of the year for the housing market.
exercises.zh: 這是一年中房地產市場最活躍的時期。
exercises.upgrade: This is the most active period of the year for the housing market.

options.explanation: 市場交易頻繁時很自然。

exercises.original: The customer service desk is busy throughout lunchtime.
exercises.zh: 客服櫃檯午飯時間一直很活躍繁忙。
exercises.upgrade: The customer service desk remains active throughout lunchtime.

words.meaning: 熙來攘往的；繁忙熱鬧的
words.note: 常形容街道、市場、城市、車站等充滿活動和人流。
words.example: The old town is a bustling tourist area.
words.exampleZh: 老城區是一個繁忙熱鬧的旅遊區。

exercises.original: The market was busy with shoppers and street vendors.
exercises.zh: 市場人來人往，非常繁忙熱鬧。
exercises.upgrade: The market was bustling with shoppers and street vendors.

options.explanation: 人流多、活動多、熱鬧，是典型 bustling。
不一定完全相反，但不表達繁忙。

exercises.original: The city centre becomes very busy in the evening.
exercises.zh: 市中心晚上變得非常繁忙熱鬧。
exercises.upgrade: The city centre becomes bustling in the evening.

options.explanation: 城市／街道熱鬧繁忙最自然。

exercises.original: The station is always busy during the evening rush.
exercises.zh: 車站在晚間繁忙時間總是熙來攘往。
exercises.upgrade: The station is always bustling during the evening rush.

words.meaning: 忙得不可開交；工作堆積如山
words.note: 口語常用，表示工作量太多，幾乎應付不來。
words.exampleZh: 我今天忙著處理大量電郵，簡直忙不過來。

exercises.original: I'm extremely busy with emails today.
exercises.zh: 我今天電郵多得忙不過來。
exercises.upgrade: I'm swamped with emails today.

options.explanation: 表示工作量大到幾乎應付不來。

exercises.original: The support team is busy with hundreds of requests.
exercises.zh: 支援團隊收到數百個要求，忙得不可開交。
exercises.upgrade: The support team is swamped with hundreds of requests.

options.explanation: 大量 requests 是典型搭配。

exercises.original: After the announcement, the office became busy with phone calls.
exercises.zh: 公告後，辦公室被大量電話弄得忙不過來。
exercises.upgrade: After the announcement, the office was swamped with phone calls.

options.explanation: 突然湧入大量工作時很自然。

words.meaning: 忙得喘不過氣；工作堆積如山
words.note: 常見慣用語，表示被大量工作壓得透不過氣。
words.example: We're snowed under with orders this week.
words.exampleZh: 我們這星期訂單多得忙不過來。

exercises.original: We're very busy with paperwork this week.
exercises.zh: 我們這星期文件工作多得忙不過來。
exercises.upgrade: We're snowed under with paperwork this week.

options.explanation: 固定慣用語，表示被大量工作壓住。

exercises.original: She's busy with reports and deadlines at the moment.
exercises.zh: 她目前報告和死線多得忙不過來。
exercises.upgrade: She's snowed under with reports and deadlines at the moment.

options.explanation: 表示工作不足，方向相反。

exercises.original: The accounting department is busy with year-end work.
exercises.zh: 會計部年終工作多得忙不過來。
exercises.upgrade: The accounting department is snowed under with year-end work.

options.explanation: 大量工作累積，非常自然。

words.meaning: 忙得腳不沾地；忙個不停
words.note: 常見英式表達，表示忙得幾乎沒有停下來的時間。
words.example: The staff were rushed off their feet during lunch.
words.exampleZh: 午餐時段員工忙得不可開交。

exercises.original: The restaurant staff were extremely busy during lunch.
exercises.zh: 餐廳員工午餐時段忙得腳不沾地。
exercises.upgrade: The restaurant staff were rushed off their feet during lunch.

options.explanation: 餐飲服務高峰期很典型。

exercises.original: The nurses were very busy all night.
exercises.zh: 護士整晚忙個不停。
exercises.upgrade: The nurses were rushed off their feet all night.

options.explanation: 醫院工作繁忙時很自然。

exercises.original: Shop staff are always busy before the holidays.
exercises.zh: 節日前店員總是忙得不可開交。
exercises.upgrade: Shop staff are always rushed off their feet before the holidays.

options.explanation: 零售高峰期的典型表達。

words.meaning: 忙得不可開交；已經應付不來更多事情
words.note: 常見固定表達，表示已有很多責任或事情要處理。
words.example: She's got her hands full with three young children.
words.exampleZh: 她照顧三個年幼孩子，已經忙得不可開交。

exercises.original: She's very busy looking after three young children.
exercises.zh: 她照顧三個年幼孩子，已經忙得不可開交。
exercises.upgrade: She has her hands full looking after three young children.

options.explanation: 大量責任已佔滿時間和精力。

exercises.original: I can't take on another project because I'm already busy.
exercises.zh: 我已經忙不過來，不能再接另一個項目。
exercises.upgrade: I can't take on another project because I already have my hands full.

options.explanation: 明確表示沒有能力再承擔更多事情。
表示仍有餘力，方向相反。

exercises.original: The manager is busy dealing with two major problems already.
exercises.zh: 經理已經要處理兩個重大問題，忙得抽不開身。
exercises.upgrade: The manager has her hands full dealing with two major problems already.

options.explanation: 已有多項重大責任，無法再加工作。

words.meaning: 超負荷的；工作量過多的
words.note: 表示某人、系統或工作流程承擔過多任務。
words.example: The team is overloaded with urgent requests.
words.exampleZh: 團隊因大量緊急要求而超負荷。

exercises.original: The team is too busy with urgent requests.
exercises.zh: 團隊因大量緊急要求而超負荷。
exercises.upgrade: The team is overloaded with urgent requests.

exercises.original: Several employees are busy because they have too many cases.
exercises.zh: 幾名員工因個案太多而工作超負荷。
exercises.upgrade: Several employees are overloaded because they have too many cases.

options.explanation: too many cases 表示超出正常工作量。

exercises.original: The system becomes busy when too many requests arrive at once.
exercises.zh: 太多請求同時進入時，系統會超負荷。
exercises.upgrade: The system becomes overloaded when too many requests arrive at once.

options.explanation: 系統負荷過高的標準說法。

words.note: 當 busy 形容電話線、房間、洗手間、設備等正在被人使用時，很自然。
words.example: The meeting room is in use at the moment.

exercises.original: The meeting room is busy at the moment.
exercises.zh: 會議室目前正在使用。
exercises.upgrade: The meeting room is in use at the moment.

options.explanation: 可使用，通常表示目前沒人用。
可能指門開／可使用，但不等於正在使用。

exercises.original: This computer is busy right now; please use another one.
exercises.zh: 這部電腦目前有人使用，請用另一部。
exercises.upgrade: This computer is in use right now; please use another one.

options.explanation: 設備正在被使用最自然。
表示目前沒有處理工作，方向不同。

exercises.original: The bathroom is busy, so you'll need to wait.
exercises.zh: 洗手間正在使用，你需要等一下。
exercises.upgrade: The bathroom is in use, so you'll need to wait.

options.explanation: 設施被人使用時最自然。

falseSynonyms.zh: 勤奮不等於忙 一個人可以 hard-working，但當下未必 busy。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is very hard-working. She is very busy today.

falseSynonyms.zh: 高效率不等於忙 productive 表示有成果；busy 只表示事情多。 一個人可以很忙但效率不高。
擠迫只適合部分 busy 語境 crowded 形容很多人／物擠在一起。 它不能表示「我工作很忙」。
受歡迎不等於繁忙 一間餐廳可能因為 popular 而 busy，但兩者意思不同。
正在工作不等於非常忙 working 只表示在工作；busy 表示有很多事情或沒有空。
高度相關，但不總等於忙 active 可指活躍，但未必帶「事情太多／沒有空」的意思。
詞性與意思不同 - occupation = 職業／佔用 - occupied = 忙著／被佔用
拼字相似但意思不同 - busy = 忙碌的 - business = 商業／生意／事情
